notes: Pixel 8 Android handset, tailnet name pixelate, with the native companion and key-only Termux SSH. Its address is canonical here so the existing tailnet policy renderer can preserve the device holder's access after the control role moves (board task 630740d5). Like lapis-lazuli, this client is excluded from compute provisioning and audit targets.
dispatch: A phone client, never a compute or provisioning target. Its companion is driven by the devices duty holder; no fleet job runs on this handset.
